subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BEAR' is written as ‘52’ and 'SINK' is written as ‘106’. How will ‘TOYS' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Coded word = 2 × (Sum of positional values)**

 
• In BEAR → 52 
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75109305dbf2875fee693ee923c338ba8dddff32c2d9e9b966ea734cafbf8946.png] 
 
• Sum of positional values = '2 + 5 + 1 + 18' = 26​​​.
 
• Coded word = 2 × 26 = 52.
